issues.message: No device_ir_flow_audit.json receipt found; flow readiness is not fully audited.

flow appears to perform a write/program/erase operation while the datasheet context describes a write/program completion condition such as tWR, busy time, ready state, or ACK polling, but the flow has no delay/poll_until/wait_until_ready step. Model the completion wait/poll generically before treating the write as complete.
